heroHeadline: Day 78: El Sapo (CJNG Military Chief) Remains Mexico's #1 Enforcement Priority — 31 Days to FIFA World Cup; Post-El Chucky Manzanillo Void; Bilateral 5-Track Pressure at Maximum
heroSubtitle: Day 78 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 78: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán 'El Sapo' (CJNG military chief) remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3). El Sapo is the last major organized anti-O3 faction leader with El Jardinero arrested April 27 and the Teuchitlán chain (El Güero Conta, El Cabo) dismantled through May 7. As CJNG's military chief, El Sapo controls what remains of CJNG's sicario recruitment networks across Jalisco, Michoacán, and Puebla — and manages the Puerto Vallarta-Manzanillo fentanyl precursor corridor. His personal security detail includes former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan former combatants. POST-EL CHUCKY MANZANILLO VOID (Day 2): Two days after the May 9 arrest of Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky' — CJNG's Manzanillo plaza boss — the port's CJNG command structure remains in transition. El 03's Grupo Élite expected to designate a replacement within 1–2 weeks. CJNG's embedded port relationships remain intact; disruption is assessed as real but temporary. The full Manzanillo two-phase dismantlement pattern (eight police arrested April 16 → El Chucky arrested May 9) is being assessed as a potential template for Port of Lázaro Cárdenas. DECAPITATION CAMPAIGN — 78-DAY LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, formally charged Altiplano May 4), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/plaza boss (arrested May 9). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, financial wing, confirmed CJNG leader — El País, April 6) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). PLAN KUKULKAN — 31 DAYS: Mexico's FIFA World Cup 2026 security strategy (Plan Kukulkan) enters final 31-day mobilization phase. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium) hosts 4 group-stage matches; Mexico's 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues. QUINTUPLE BILATERAL PRESSURE TRACK — MAXIMUM STRESS: (1) CIA-Chihuahua sovereignty deadlock (constitutional impasse — Maru Campos declined April 28 Senate hearing); (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials (on 'temporary leave' since May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (May 6); (4) U.S. State Dept formal review of all 53 Mexican consulates (May 7–8); (5) ongoing CJNG interdiction (El Chucky arrest May 9). Trump's May 7 warning ('if they're not gonna do the job, we will') remains the maximum rhetorical escalation point. CHATHAM HOUSE ASSESSMENT: Mexico's anti-cartel operations are 'partly performative — calibrated to impress international partners' — the El Sapo capture and lasting Manzanillo disruption are the key metrics for assessing whether the campaign achieves structural vs. symbolic impact.
